properties.notes: The 3M Company produced PFAS at its Cottage Grove facility from the late 1940's until 2002. (MN Dept of Health - PFAS Sites in Minnesota)

Environmental sampling determined that PFAS in the groundwater in Lake Elmo come from both the former Washington County Landfill and the 3M-Oakdale Disposal Site. PFAS at the site in Oakdale enter Raleigh Creek, which flows east to the city of Lake Elmo and discharges into Eagle Point Lake in the Lake Elmo Park Reserve. As the PFAS travel in the creek, some infiltrate into the groundwater and combine with PFAS already in the groundwater from the former Washington County Landfill. (Minnesota Dept of Health - PFAS Sites in Minnesota)
